editorial.blurb: Bourgeois Pig Cafe is a charming vintage hideaway in Lincoln Park where great coffee, satisfying sandwiches, and nostalgic ambiance make you want to settle in for hours.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive with time to spare during busy hours to snag a cozy nook—reviewers stayed for 4+ hours studying and reading, so give yourself space to get comfortable.

topDishes.note: World Famous Tuna Dill Salad on house-made multigrain bread with bright dill, crisp vegetables, and perfectly toasted crust
Reviewers rave about this sandwich as delicious and worth the visit
